transform.stimulus: raw measured CSV stimulus; aggregate/source signal, no invented per-input waveform
transform.events: observed packet events, not expected schedule
transform.potential_input_overlay: actual full-before CSV stimulus on every soma overview and zoom; original timestamps translated by that observed origin; independent labelled right raw-unit axis with visible height about one eighth; no synthetic per-input pulses
transform.control_input_overlay: each control panel uses that control own measured CSV stimulus on independently labelled right raw-unit axis
transform.basin: recorded full-before valley bounds: left.last_sample through right.first_sample; no recomputed selection
transform.local_y: per-channel min/max among all recorded controls inside zoom X range, plus explicit margin; exact limits recorded
